description: This file contains test cases for the 'mention gating' logic, specifically testing functions 'resolveMentionGating' and 'resolveMentionGatingWithBypass'. It uses the 'vitest' testing framework to verify behavior under various scenarios involving mention detection, bypass conditions, and command authorization.

methods.name: resolveMentionGating
methods.description: Function that determines effective mention status and whether to skip processing based on mention requirements and detection capabilities.
